answer.summary: All 3 failures are XtmHubEmailRecipientsTest errors where inserting into roles is rejected by the DB trigger function require_tenant_write, which says platform-row writes need a platform-write transaction and writes to tenant rows need that tenant in scope. The change adds the V6 Guard_roles_and_role_links migration and touches tenant/access-control code, so the guard is most likely the cause. The failure is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. Unrelated noise in the log (engine down, smtp down, NPE in PreviewFeatureService) is not what failed the build.

evidence.quote: Where: PL/pgSQL function require_tenant_write(text,boolean) line 7 at RAISE
Caused by: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: write of a platform row refused: the transaction is not platform-write
Caused by: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: write of a row of tenant 855f5d87-0164-4252-917f-dd72080c181a refused: outside the scope of the transaction
Caused by: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: write of a row of tenant 47c8b817-bf97-445d-a732-1dfc207b7be2 refused: outside the scope of the transaction
